removed_entries: Raised on the brutal streets of the Dross Wards by a disgraced gladiator
Abandoned at the rusted gates of the Crying Mothers sanctuary
Abandoned at the rusted iron doors of the Silent Brothers
waiting for the moment they could bathe the arena sands in the blood of their oppressors
knowing that the only escape from the gutters was paved in blood
waiting for the moment the crowd screams a name that was once forbidden
